segments.title: Chương 112: 0112 [Tuổi trẻ khởi nghiệp đầy nhiệt huyết]
segments.content:
The new innovation center was still under renovation, so Chen Guiliang signed the loan at the old innovation center.

A leader from Peking University Science Park Incubator Company came. He was about 50 years old. For now, let's call him Teacher Li.

Wang Kai helped him apply for two basic types of seed loans:

First, a general debt loan of 500,000 yuan with an annual interest rate of 2%. Within two years, he could pay back only the interest, and within five years, he had to repay all principal and interest.

Second, a convertible bond loan of 800,000 yuan (special approval) with a 0% annual interest rate.

Chen Guiliang chose the first option.

After the loan contract was signed, Chen Guiliang shook hands with Teacher Li, while Wang Kai stood beside them, smiling and applauding.

This time, not only did reporters from the school newspaper come, but reporters from the school's TV station came as well.

Of course, the school TV station didn't have many viewers; its influence was far less than that of the school newspaper.

Both groups of reporters conducted a brief interview with Chen Guiliang. This was mainly used to highlight the achievements of the Science Park leaders.

"Young and promising! I wish you great success!" Teacher Li said with a beaming smile.

Chen Guiliang said, "We still rely on the support of our leaders."

After exchanging a few more pleasantries, Teacher Li left in a hurry, probably with other matters to attend to.

Chen Guiliang, on the other hand, had prepared a "travel stipend" for the reporters. Well, he gave each of them a set of "Sanguosha." For those without a Xiaonei account, he also gave them an invitation code.

After sending the reporters off, Chen Guiliang rushed to the Science Park building without stopping.

The first and second floors were public service and exhibition areas, with a lobby, conference rooms, a coffee shop, park management offices, and so on. Some areas were used to display corporate achievements.

Chen Guiliang's company was on the third floor.

This floor was primarily for student startup teams. The office spaces were very small, ranging from 20 to 50 square meters each, with ultra-low rent. Some were even rent-free (Chen Guiliang could have gotten free rent if he had chosen the convertible bond loan).

The fourth floor housed joint laboratories between the university and enterprises, as well as companies started by graduated alumni.

The fifth floor was for companies in the Science Park's self-operated incubator program.

The sixth floor and above were office areas for mature companies. It was said that Founder Group would also be moving in.

Chen Guiliang rented two adjacent offices, each 50 square meters. The total rent for both was only 24,000 yuan a year.

He couldn't rent more; one office per project, and he could only sign for three years.

After three years, if the company had grown, it would have to move to the sixth floor or above, where the rent would revert to the normal rate.

If the office space became insufficient within three years, he could apply to add more offices or move directly to the sixth floor or above.

"How long will the renovation take?" Chen Guiliang asked, standing at the door.

Ao Yanchen said, "8 days at the fastest, 10 at the slowest. A simple renovation won't take long. Once the office equipment is in, we can air it out for a few days and then move in. Did you get the loan?"

"It's signed," Chen Guiliang said. "It'll be in the account within a week."

Ao Yanchen let out a sigh of relief. "As long as we have the money. I was afraid... never mind, let's not say anything unlucky."

Chen Guiliang asked, "I see the office next door is also being renovated. What company is it?"

Ao Yanchen said, "It's a company founded jointly by teachers and students from the School of Education, called 'Weiming Interactive.' They're building an online education platform."

"That's some ambitious thinking," Chen Guiliang remarked with a sigh.

Ao Yan lowered his voice, "Do you think they'll fail?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I wish them success."

The company next door, Weiming Interactive, was started by teachers and students from the School of Education. Later, due to limitations in bandwidth and payment technology, online education simply couldn't get off the ground. It eventually transformed into a service provider for university teaching management systems.

Ao Yanchen continued, "There are two other companies renovating upstairs. One is called Kexin Bio, which does gene testing and biological reagent R&D. The other is called Kangliming Medical, which makes medical imaging analysis software."

"Sounds much more high-end than us," Chen Guiliang said with a smile. "I'm going to walk around and visit our neighbors."

He first went to the online education company next door, where only a fourth-year senior was overseeing the renovation.

"Hello, senior. I'm from Bytedance and Game Science next door. My name is Chen Guiliang." Chen Guiliang stepped forward to shake his hand.

Perhaps because the company was newly founded, this senior was full of ambition and in high spirits, grinning so wide you could almost see his tonsils. "Hello, hello, I've heard so much about you. My name is Zhai Bo, a fourth-year from the School of Education."

"Senior Zhai, you've got guts. Online education is a truly pioneering field in China," Chen Guiliang complimented.

Zhai Bo said, "I'm just a minor shareholder, here to watch over the renovations. The other shareholders are all busy. There are teachers from the School of Education, and also senior brothers and sisters who are doing their graduate studies."

Chen Guiliang made some more small talk and exchanged phone numbers with the senior.

Zhai Bo said, "Your 'Sanguosha' is really famous. The guys in the dorm next to mine are playing it. But what is Xiaonei for?"

Chen Guiliang gave a simple explanation and also gave Zhai Bo an invitation code.

Finishing their chat, he prepared to go check out the fourth floor.

When the elevator doors opened, seven or eight students flooded out.

Chen Guiliang didn't get into the elevator, but curiously followed them.

He saw a mature-looking student point at an unrenovated office and say, "This is our company's address. I'm already in contact with a renovation company."

"Wow, the office is so big! It must be thirty or forty square meters, right?"

"That's where our dreams will take flight. Brothers and sisters, a historic moment has arrived!"

"I want the seat by the window."

The senior brothers and sisters were extremely excited, practically dancing as they spoke.

Someone asked Chen Guiliang, "What company are they starting?"

"Haha, you know him. That's Chen Guiliang!" a senior brother said.

A senior sister said, "I know you're famous. What kind of business are they starting?"

"Academic publishing."

"Huh?"

Chen Guiliang thought he had misheard. The Peking University Science Park could even incubate a publishing company?

One senior sister explained passionately, "We specialize in sorting ancient texts and printing academic manuscripts. Oh right, we are students from the Chinese and History departments."

Chen Guiliang said, "I also love Chinese and History. I wish your publishing company a booming business and great success."

"Haha, I'll take that as a good omen. I wish you booming business as well," the senior brothers and sisters said, all smiles.

Chen Guiliang looked at the group of high-spirited students and could imagine their dejected expressions before their venture failed.

Specializing in sorting ancient texts and printing academic manuscripts...

It would be impressive if they could last a year.

The fact that the Peking University Science Park was willing to give such a doomed project a chance could only mean that the university was indeed very supportive of student entrepreneurship.

That company was called Boya Shushe. Of course, it went bankrupt later and was taken over by Peking University Press.

Chen Guiliang asked them for their phone numbers, then went downstairs to continue wandering around and saw a young man pacing back and forth.

"Hello, senior. I'm Chen Guiliang, my company is upstairs," Chen Guiliang went up to greet him.

The young man said, "Hello, my name is Ao Yan, a shareholder of Qingniao Kexun. I'm here to choose an office today. What's your company's name?"

Chen Guiliang said, "One is called Bytedance, the other is Game Science."

"You started two companies by yourself? You must be graduating soon, right?" Ao Yan was extremely surprised.

Chen Guiliang said, "I'm a freshman."

Ao Yan: "..."

Ao Yan had graduated last year.

After chatting for a bit, Chen Guiliang was a little speechless. Another one doing online education.

The company's name was Qingniao Kexun.

However, the founding team wasn't from the School of Education, but was led by graduates from the Computer Science department.

Upon hearing that the company's founding team was all computer science graduates, Chen Guiliang quickly asked for his contact information.

Once this company went under, perhaps he could seize the opportunity to recruit a few programmers.

"Bro, you're truly amazing! Daring to start a business as a freshman, and two at once," Ao Yan said with sincere admiration. "Our company became an incubation project last year, and we're still struggling to survive."

Chen Guiliang asked curiously, "You've been doing online education for a year?"

Ao Yan nodded. "It's too difficult. The internet speed can't keep up, and making payments is also very troublesome. Our project has been losing money. The loan we applied for has been spent, and now not only can we not pay salaries, but we all have to take on freelance projects to earn money to support the company."

This left Chen Guiliang somewhat silent.

The company couldn't turn a profit, the loan was spent, employees weren't getting paid, and they even had to work side jobs to support the company...

Running on love.

Chen Guiliang asked, "Is it just the founding team left?"

"Yeah," Ao Yan nodded. "Fortunately, the teachers at the Science Park have always supported us. Now that we've moved to the new building, the office rent is completely waived. We can only do a simple renovation, and I reckon the shareholders will have to scrape the putty themselves."

Chen Guiliang asked curiously, "Are you going to continue with online education?"

Ao Yan shook his head. "Online education probably won't work out. We plan to pivot to being a corporate training SaaS service provider."

"I wish you good luck," Chen Guiliang said, shaking his hand.

"I wish you a smooth start to your business too," Ao Yan said. "Can I take a look at your company?"

"I'd be delighted."

The two took the elevator upstairs. When they passed by Weiming Interactive, Chen Guiliang said in a low voice, "They're also doing online education. The company hasn't even opened yet."

Ao Yan stared at the renovating Weiming Interactive office with the gaze one might use for a dead man. "I hope they can make it work and not follow our old path. With China's crappy internet speeds and payment systems, doing online education is just too hard."

Chen Guiliang's two companies were still under renovation, so there wasn't much to see. Ao Yan was just coming by to get acquainted.

They were all alumni; who knew when they might be able to help each other out.

After shooting the breeze with Ao Yan, Chen Guiliang went upstairs again to see the high-tech companies.

One of them even had its sign up, reading "xxx Biotechnology Laboratory." The name alone sounded very impressive. After some inquiries, he learned it was started by doctoral students from the School of Life Sciences.

No matter what they did, Chen Guiliang went to ask for their phone numbers anyway.

Chen Guiliang made a round of the third, fourth, and fifth floors, truly broadening his horizons. There were all sorts of startups.

He estimated that over half of these companies would be dead within two years.

Even if they didn't die, they would have to pivot and change their current main business.

Many students, including teachers, were very blind when it came to starting businesses. But Peking University Science Park was willing to support them, and quite a few had received seed fund loans.

This year's Peking University Science Park was indeed advancing a bit too furiously.

Chen Guiliang returned to his old office, gathered everyone for a meeting, and officially announced the launch of the "Campus Belle Selection Plan."
